Maya: Quick async question re: /v1/generate contract — we're seeing ambiguous behavior for stop sequences vs max_tokens. Example: prompt='List: 1.' with stop=["\n"] and max_tokens=1. If the generator emits a partial whitespace or partial subtoken and we hit max_tokens, do we treat stop as not matched (so no stop token) and mark truncated=true, or do we prefer stop precedence? Need to confirm spec for compatibility docs.
Oliver: Short answer: stop precedence only triggers if the emitted token sequence contains the full stop string before truncation. If max_tokens cuts the token such that stop isn't fully emitted, it's considered truncated. We should document this.
Samira: Can you paste a minimal repro (curl) so I can run against local runtime? Also need to check logprobs behavior for truncated tokens.
Maya: Yep — repro:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"List: 1.","max_tokens":1,"stop":["\n"],"logprobs":5}'
```
Oliver: When truncated mid-token we return tokens up to the limit and set `truncated: true` in meta. For `logprobs` we include probabilities for emitted (possibly partial) token pieces as produced by tokenizer/kernels. We DON'T fabricate probabilities for a missing token. That can look odd in clients that expect token-aligned ASCII; we should call this out in API. 
Jordan: For backward compatibility: older clients might assume stop strings are atomic. Recommend we add a one-line compatibility note and example to the gen params docs and a test in contract tests.
Li: Also flagging streaming: for chunked streaming we may emit the partial token then stream ends — clients should assemble and check stop when final chunk arrives. Maybe add an advisory in streaming docs.
Samira: I'll open a tiny PR with docs + a unit test that asserts stop only matches on full string and logprobs present for emitted pieces. Ping me for code review.
Maya: Thanks — ping @Samira when PR ready. Also can we add a quick follow-up test for function-calling where stop sequences interact with tool outputs? Maybe later.
deploy-bot: canary deployment for runtime-rwd-small queued at 2078901300 :rocket:
Anna: FYI PM note — we'll surface this in the next release notes.
Maya: Great, keeping this thread as async record. /closing
